capabilities: Display a column of short lines beside the note, one per heading
Expand the outline into a heading list on hover
Jump to a heading by clicking it
Indent nested headings and highlight the current section
Follow the active theme via Obsidian theme variables
extras: Desktop only; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A minimal, hover-to-expand outline of your note's headings, shown beside the document.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline takes up panel space; this shows a compact heading column that only expands on hover.
summary: Minimal hover-to-expand outline of a note's headings, shown as a column beside the document.
